name: adapt_renamed_symbol_typescript_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval, REACTIVE trigger: the disruption fires the first time area.ts's own text contains 'circleArea' (i.e. once the agent has produced a first attempt), then mathutils.square is RENAMED to mathutils.sq under it
prompts: mathutils.ts exports a function square(x: number): number. Create area.ts that exports a function circleArea(r: number): number returning 3.14159 * square(r), importing square from './mathutils'.
mathutils.ts's square function has just been renamed to sq. Update area.ts to use the new name (do not keep a reference to the old name square).

disruptions.description: mathutils.square renamed to mathutils.sq, triggered reactively once area.ts's first draft appeared

check_command: tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build mathutils.ts area.ts test_area.ts && node build/test_area.js
